description_target.target_text: Nested rect placement: largest rect = output container, smaller rects placed by aligning shared color markers

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; The largest multicolor blob is the CONTAINER — its crop is the
 ;; canvas. Every remaining piece shares a color X (besides the
 ;; container's own) with the canvas: slide the piece window across
 ;; the canvas until its X-cells coincide EXACTLY with the canvas's
 ;; X-cells there, then paste the piece in. Pieces land biggest-first
 ;; onto the evolving canvas.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g))
     (define objs
       (sort (objects-multicolor g bg)
             (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
     (define container (first objs))
     (define c-color  ;; the container's dominant color
       (pick-max (remove-duplicates
                  (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
                       (obj-cells container)))
                 (lambda (v)
                   (count-if (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p))
                                            v))
                             (obj-cells container)))))
     (define (colors-of grid)  ;; non-bg colors, latest-seen first
       (reverse (remove-duplicates
                 (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg)))
                         (apply append grid)))))
     (define (place out piece)
       (let* ((rect (subgrid g (obj-r1 piece) (obj-c1 piece)
                             (obj-r2 piece) (obj-c2 piece)))
              (rh (rows rect))
              (rw (cols rect))
              (common (filter (lambda (v)
                                (and (not (= v c-color))
                                     (member? v (colors-of out))))
                              (colors-of rect)))
              (X (if (null? common) #f (first common))))
         (if (not X)
             out
             (let ((hit  ;; first window where the X-cells align
                    (find-first
                     (lambda (off)
                       (let* ((dr (first off)) (dc (second off))
                              (rect-X (for*/list ((lr (range 0 rh))
                                                  (lc (range 0 rw))
                                                  #:when (= (at rect lr
                                                               lc)
                                                            X))
                                        (list (+ lr dr) (+ lc dc))))
                              (out-X (for*/list ((r (range dr
                                                           (+ dr rh)))
                                                 (c (range dc
                                                           (+ dc rw)))
                                                 #:when (= (at out r c)
                                                           X))
                                       (list r c))))
                         (and (not (null? rect-X))
                              (= (length rect-X) (length out-X))
                              (all? (lambda (p) (member p out-X))
                                    rect-X))))
                     (for*/list ((dr (range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows out) rh))))
                                 (dc (range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols out)
                                                      rw)))))
                       (list dr dc)))))
               (if hit
                   (paint-cells out
                                (for*/list ((lr (range 0 rh))
                                            (lc (range 0 rw))
                                            #:when (not (= (at rect lr
                                                              lc)
                                                           bg)))
                                  (list (+ lr (first hit))
                                        (+ lc (second hit))
                                        (at rect lr lc))))
                   out)))))
     (for/fold ((out (subgrid g (obj-r1 container) (obj-c1 container)
                              (obj-r2 container) (obj-c2 container))))
               ((piece (rest objs)))
       (place out piece)))))
racket_target.target_code:
(rule!
 ;; Crop the largest multicolor object as the canvas.  Every smaller piece
 ;; shares one marker color with that canvas; paste it at the unique window
 ;; whose marker cells match exactly.  Process pieces largest-first.
 (lambda (g)
   (define bg (mode g))
   (define objs
     (sort (objects-multicolor g bg)
           (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
   (define container (first objs))
   (define c-fill (mode-in (obj-cells container) g bg))
   (define (palette grid)
     (reverse
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v bg))) (apply append grid)))))
   (define (place out obj)
     (define piece (crop-object g obj))
     (define ph (rows piece))
     (define pw (cols piece))
     (define marker
       (find-first
        (lambda (v) (and (not (= v c-fill)) (member? v (palette out))))
        (palette piece)))
     (if (not marker)
         out
         (let* ((piece-marks (find-color piece marker))
                (hit
                 (find-first
                  (lambda (off)
                    (define dr (first off))
                    (define dc (second off))
                    (equal?
                     piece-marks
                     (for*/list ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 pw))
                                 #:when (= (at out (+ dr r) (+ dc c)) marker))
                       (list r c))))
                  (for*/list ((dr (range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows out) ph))))
                              (dc (range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols out) pw)))))
                    (list dr dc)))))
           (if hit
               (paint-cells
                out
                (for*/list ((r (range 0 ph)) (c (range 0 pw))
                            #:when (not (= (at piece r c) bg)))
                  (list (+ r (first hit)) (+ c (second hit)) (at piece r c))))
               out))))
   (foldl (lambda (piece out) (place out piece))
          (crop-object g container)
          (rest objs))))
